sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 340. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 60 seconds: Recovers 20% of max HP when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Increases wind elemental attack by 14 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases wind elemental attack buff limit by 4 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
Boosts stats of wind Monsters by 30% when equipped in the Main Slot.
